arguments.text: Stage 3 implementation verification: work.py validates each row in order with priority id, amount, unit, duplicate; rejects bool/non-number/negative/nonfinite amounts; defaults missing unit to base_unit; converts valid amounts; clears all records on any error; and does not mutate tested inputs. Current policy.json + requests.json evaluates exactly to report.json. Independent boundary checks covered successful conversion/defaulting, all four error priorities, duplicate tracking, NaN/infinity/negative amounts, batch atomicity, and input immutability. evidence.json is absent.
